displayIdentity.body: Judgment distinguishes insiders from outsiders. I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners; But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
displayIdentity.title: Judgment distinguishes insiders from outsiders
